attchmntText: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited has informed the Exchange regarding voting results of  Postal Ballot
voiceSummary: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited announces the voting results for the postal ballot regarding the sale of Hotel Novotel Imagicaa. The special resolution was passed by members on November 20, 2026. The resolution seeks approval for the slump sale of the hotel under Section 180(1)(a) of the Companies Act, 2013. Voting occurred via remote e-voting from October 22, 2026, to November 20, 2026. Total valid votes polled were 41,93,21,061 shares. Votes in favor totaled 41,93,21,061 shares, representing 99.9324 percent. Votes against totaled 2,83,507 shares, representing 0.0676 percent. No invalid votes were recorded. The Scrutinizer, Mitesh Dhabliwala, submitted the report on November 23, 2026. The results are available on the company website.

attchmntText: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication regarding Notice of Extraordinary General Meeting to be held on Friday, December 11, 2026
voiceSummary: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited published a notice for its Extraordinary General Meeting Number 01/2026-27 on November 19, 2026. The meeting is scheduled for Friday, December 11, 2026, at 11:00 AM. The agenda includes the reappointment of directors and the appointment of auditors. The notice is available on the company website and stock exchange portals. Additionally, a public notice by Advocate S. M. Kanade states that clients are acquiring property units from Mr. Ravi Ishwar Ghanashani. Claims regarding these units must be submitted within seven working days. The Bombay High Court bench comprising Justices Deepak Gupta, J.B. Pardiwala, and V.K. Jain has issued notices in a case regarding alleged irregularities in the appointment of the Chief Information Security Officer. The next hearing is set for January 20, 2027. Zoroastrian Bank Limited has issued a public notice under Section 8(6) of the SARFAESI Act, 2002, regarding the sale of secured assets to recover dues of Rs. 1,52,32,442.62. The sale process involves online bidding.

attchmntText: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Extraordinary General Meeting to be held on December 11, 2026
voiceSummary: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited has issued a notice for Extraordinary General Meeting Number 01/2026-27 to be held on December 11, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. via video conferencing. The meeting will consider a special resolution to issue up to 22,10,885 convertible warrants to Bennett, Coleman and Company Limited on a preferential basis. Each warrant carries an entitlement to subscribe to one equity share of face value Rs. 10 at a price of Rs. 73.50. The total aggregation value is up to Rs. 16,25,00,047.50. The relevant date for determining the minimum price is November 11, 2026. Warrants must be exercised within 18 months of allotment. At least 25% of the issue price is payable at allotment, with the balance 75% payable upon conversion. E-voting commences on December 8, 2026, at 09:00 a.m. and ends on December 10, 2026, at 05:00 p.m. The resolution is pending shareholder approval.
